description: Evals cho QD6 Data Integrity + Schema Drift Lane — kiem tra PRE-GATE validation, probe signal emission, va POST-GATE schema compliance.

test_cases.name: PRE-GATE fail khi SESSION_DIR khong ton tai

input.scenario: wf-fix-data duoc spawn voi --session-dir=/tmp/nonexistent-session-999 nhung directory khong ton tai

expected.behavior: STOP voi E001: SESSION_DIR khong ton tai

test_cases.validation: Skill KHONG tao phase4-find-bugs/lanes/QD6-data/ subdirectory. In error message voi E001 va exit. KHONG tiep tuc sang Phase 1 SENSE.

test_cases.name: P-QD6-schema-drift-detect emit signal cho schema drift giua DB va ORM model

input.scenario: Database co column 'discount_rate DECIMAL(5,2)' nhung ORM model dinh nghia 'discount_rate: number' khong co precision constraint. Migration gan nhat khong co down() method.

test_cases.validation: Signal thu nhat co probe_id='P-QD6-schema-drift-detect', dimension_id='QD6', evidence chua DB column spec va ORM model mismatch. Signal thu hai co probe_id='P-QD6-migration-integrity', severity='critical' vi migration thieu down(). Moi signal co description >=10 ky tu va it nhat 1 evidence field non-empty (ADR-09).

test_cases.name: POST-GATE T1-T4 pass cho valid signals.json voi 3 signals tu quick profile

input.scenario: Lane chay xong voi profile quick, 3 signals hop le tu 3 probes (schema-drift-detect, migration-integrity, constraint-violation), moi signal co probe_id, dimension_id='QD6', va evidence non-empty

test_cases.validation: POST-GATE T1: signals.json ton tai va non-empty (test -s). T2: jq parse OK + $schema='lane-signals-v1' + signals[] la array. T3: moi signal co probe_id + dimension_id='QD6' + evidence co >=1 field non-empty. T4: moi probe_id match pattern ^P-QD[1-8]-[a-z0-9-]+$. lane-report.md tu template lane-report.md, phase-summary.md <=15 dong tieng Viet (CORE-028).

test_cases.name: Profile standard chay 5 probes, profile deep chay 6 probes (ALL)

input.scenario: Kiem tra rang profile quick chay 3 probes, standard chay 5 probes, deep chay 6 probes (ALL) theo dimension.json exit_criteria

test_cases.validation: Profile quick: 3 probes required (schema-drift-detect, migration-integrity, constraint-violation). Standard: 5 probes (quick + data-type-mismatch, orm-model-sync). Deep: ALL 6 probes (standard + seed-data-audit). Probes khong trong profile duoc skip va ghi vao lane-report.md 'Probes bo qua'.

test_cases.name: Schema uniformity: signals.json conform signal-v2 (lane-status-v1)
test_cases.description: S11 schema uniformity check — output signals.json cua QD6 lane phai conform _shared/lane/templates/signals.json schema (signal-v2). Validate qua wf-fix-validate-gate.sh script.

input.scenario: Spawn wf-fix-data voi profile=standard, mock SESSION_DIR co req-registry.json + features. Sau khi probe chay xong → check signals.json validate.

test_cases.validation: wf-fix-validate-gate.sh tra exit 0 + signals[*].lane='QD6' + signals[*].dimension_id='QD6'. Edge: signal thieu required field → exit 1 + error message ro field name.

test_cases.name: Probe lazy-load: SKILL.md routing table list 6 probes, nhung CHI load probe matching profile
test_cases.description: S11 lazy-load verification — SKILL.md routing table cho QD6 lane phai liet ke 6 probes voi profile filter (quick/standard/deep). Khi profile=quick, CHI load probes co quick filter, KHONG load probes deep-only (lazy-load).

input.scenario: Spawn wf-fix-data voi 3 profile khac nhau (quick/standard/deep). Verify routing table behavior + count files actually read tu probes/ folder.

expected.standard_profile_loads: subset rong hon (probes co standard filter)

test_cases.validation: Routing table trong SKILL.md (line ~30-50) liet ke chinh xac 6 probes. Profile filter respected: quick KHONG load deep-only probes. SKILL.md size 130-180 dong (S4 chuan hoa).

test_cases.name: D9 audit CRITICAL: CDG handler hardcoded empty — DROP TABLE khong trigger CDG
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D9 + Phase 4: All QD6 probe specs co cdg_flags: [] hardcoded empty list. Dieu nay co nghia DROP TABLE/DROP DATABASE operations trong migration files KHONG trigger CDG notification → DATA LOSS risk. IMP-QD6-013 (P0 DATA LOSS RISK via IMP-024): fix cdg_flags để DROP operations trigger CDG-DATA-DROP.

input.scenario: Migration file co: await queryRunner.query('DROP TABLE users CASCADE'). P-QD6-migration-integrity phat hien DROP TABLE nhung cdg_flags=[] → CDG-DATA-DROP KHONG duoc emit.

expected.current_behavior: DROP TABLE detected but CDG flag NOT emitted (cdg_flags=[]) → orchestrator not notified → no human review gate
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD6_013: CDG-DATA-DROP flag emitted → orchestrator halts pipeline → requires human confirmation before continuing
expected.data_loss_risk: CRITICAL — DROP TABLE silently passes QD6 without CDG gate

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD6-013: cdg_flags=[] → DROP TABLE bypass CDG gate → data loss possible. SAU IMP-QD6-013: migration probe phai emit CDG-DATA-DROP khi detect DROP TABLE/DROP DATABASE/TRUNCATE. Orchestrator phai HALT. IMP-024 CDG Governance (5-dim global) merge cluster.
test_cases.audit_ref: 07-qd6-data-audit.md Phase 2 D9 + Phase 4 CDG governance gap + IMP-QD6-013 + IMP-024

test_cases.name: D11 audit: tat ca 6 probes QD6 la inline-only — khong co bash dispatch
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D11: Tat ca 6 QD6 probes (schema-drift-detect, migration-integrity, constraint-violation, data-type-mismatch, orm-model-sync, seed-data-audit) la inline SKILL.md text, KHONG co bash scripts. Contrast: QD1/QD3/QD5/QD7 co dedicated bash scripts. Dieu nay lam QD6 phu thuoc vao AI reasoning cho tat ca detection. IMP-QD6-010 (P1 MERGE voi IMP-025 bash dispatch): them bash script cho P-QD6-schema-drift-detect it nhat.

input.scenario: Spawn wf-fix-data voi profile=standard. Kiem tra xem co bash script nao duoc invoke tu probes/ folder khong.

expected.current_behavior: 0 bash scripts in probes/ — all detection via AI reasoning (inline probe instructions)
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD6_010: At least P-QD6-schema-drift-detect has dedicated bash script for ORM vs DB comparison
expected.detection_reliability: Inline AI-only detection has higher variance than bash deterministic patterns

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD6-010: ls probes/ phai tra ve 0 .sh files → tat ca inline. SAU IMP-QD6-010: co it nhat 1 bash script cho schema drift detection. IMP-025 bash dispatch standardization (3-dim: QD2/QD4/QD6) global merge cluster.
test_cases.audit_ref: 07-qd6-data-audit.md Phase 2 D11 + IMP-QD6-010 + IMP-025 bash dispatch global

test_cases.name: Phase 3 audit: EF Core C# decorator-based schema drift duoc detect dung

Fixtures qd6-test/ dung C# EF Core code (khong phai TypeScript/Python) — verify probe hoat dong voi C# ORM pattern. P=R=F1=1.00 dat duoc trong Phase 3 (Phien 17).

input.scenario: EF Core entity khai bao [Column(TypeName='decimal(18,2)')] cho 'Price' nhung DB thuc co DECIMAL(10,4). ORM model va DB khong khop → schema drift.

test_cases.validation: Probe phat hien mismatch giua EF Core [Column] attribute va DB schema. Evidence phai chua ca db_type va orm_type. Edge: [Column] match DB type → KHONG emit false positive. Fixture verified Phase 3 Phien 17: P=1.00 R=1.00 F1=1.00 tren 5 pos + 5 neg C# fixtures.
